segments.summary: Reviewed SP-225 through SP-228: activation quarantine storage, container-host retention, bounded histories, and background-resource quotas. Exact contracts are present, but Advanced/Support redaction, cleanup state transitions, concrete history budgets, quota precedence, recovery, and GUI control states remain materially open.

Reviewed SP-229 through SP-232 and every intervening core line: cross-runtime resource governance, EventRecord persistence, the storage value registry, coordination canon, and bounded storage addenda. Strong authority boundaries coexist with open resource policy, partial-failure, projection recovery, and over-capacity behavior.

Reviewed SP-233 and SP-234 plus all audit-lineage and Usage addendum lines. Governance projection authority and Usage joins are explicit, while trust recovery, Usage requiredness, stale/degraded GUI behavior, alias conversion, and payload-reference lifecycle remain under-specified.
